name: Graphite
tagline: Code review platform built around stacked PRs, with an AI reviewer (formerly Diamond), merge queue, and review automation for GitHub.
pricing: Hobby free (limited AI reviews); Starter $20/user/mo; Team $40/user/mo (annual) with unlimited AI reviews and merge queue; Enterprise custom
selfHostedNote: Cloud-only; GitHub Enterprise Server support only on the Enterprise tier.
